brokers-manifesto.art_direction: Aggressive neo-brutalist editorial collage, classical marble sculpture, acid-lime brush strokes, black-and-white industrial engraving, halftone and torn paper. High contrast; no corporate stock photography.

technical-deconstruction.art_direction: Spare black ink architectural line drawing on warm paper, exploded mechanical components, technical grid details and selective acid-lime circuitry. Generous negative space, precise line work; not a dense collage.

neo-pop-brutalism.art_direction: Classical sculpture against oversized geometric cutouts, flat acid lime and limited electric purple, hard shadows and angular graphic shapes. Contemporary neo-pop art; strong silhouette, less distressed texture.

industrial-editorial.art_direction: Monochrome industrial printmaking, bold machinery silhouettes, diagrammatic composition, restrained acid-lime highlights, warm-paper background and asymmetric magazine layout.
